proofStanding: replayed witness proxies; UNKNOWN for bounded misses; heuristic_observation for archive generalization

definitions.depthAxis: registered successful-witness peak merge depth: depth 1 versus depth 2 or greater
definitions.spreadAxis: registered successful-witness mean normalized chain span: compact below 0.82, broad at or above 0.82
definitions.archiveQuality: cross-width exact cell agreement, then lower spread delta; this is measurement reproducibility, not gameplay quality

P1.required: SUPPORTED at >=120/128 deep witnesses across all profiles; FALSIFIED below 96 or any profile absent

P2.required: SUPPORTED when all four cells retain four representatives; FALSIFIED when at most two cells are occupied

P3.required: SUPPORTED at >=112 paired witnesses and >=75% exact cell stability; FALSIFIED below 96 pairs or 50% stability
